subject: Follow-up: Finrize security discovery — DPA route, SCC module choice, SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Ariela Ramos <ariela@finrize.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finrize.com, security@finrize.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap — security & compliance items

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good overview. A quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can progress procurement: 

- SOC 2: Can you confirm whether Redwood has SOC 2 Type II? If not, do you have an anticipated date and any interim artifacts (bridge letter, controls summary) we can rely on for procurement?
- GDPR / DPA: We need a DPA executed with SCCs for EU data. Please indicate whether Redwood will act as data controller or processor for the Finrize integration.
- SCC module: If processor, we typically prefer Module 2 with our additional processing terms; if controller, we'll need mapping and justification.
- Vendor questionnaire: We attached our standard vendor security questionnaire (Finrize_Vendor_Q.pdf) — can you confirm ownership and point person for completion?

Next steps we need from Redwood to proceed to contracting: SOC 2 evidence (or timeline), proposed DPA draft or template, and a named resource to complete the questionnaire.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short follow-up call if helpful.

Best,
Ariela
VP, Security & Compliance
Finrize Inc

[Attachment: Finrize_Vendor_Q.pdf (PDF)]

From: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
To: Ariela Ramos <ariela@finrize.com>
Cc: procurement@finrize.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap — security & compliance items

Hi Ariela — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

1) SOC 2 status
- Redwood currently has SOC 2 Type I (completed Q2 2025) and we are in progress for Type II; expected completion: end of Q4 2026.
- Interim artifacts: we can share our SOC 2 controls summary and a bridge letter that outlines coverage and timeline. Attached is a short bridge-letter stub to start (SOC2_bridge_letter_stub.pdf).

2) GDPR / DPA & controller/processor role
- For the standard Redwood inference API usage, Redwood operates as a processor; customers remain controllers for their input data. That is our default stance and aligns with how we handle customer-owned prompts/data.
- We can accept SCCs under Module 2 and include a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) with the usual processing clauses. To speed legal review, I attached a Redwood DPA draft (Redwood_DPA_draft_v1.docx) — feel free to redline.

3) Vendor questionnaire
- Stephanie (cc'd) will take ownership of the vendor questionnaire. Stephanie — can you confirm ETA to return the completed Finrize_Vendor_Q (we typically need ~3 business days for the full doc)?

Proposed next steps:
- Stephanie returns the completed questionnaire and SOC 2 artifacts by Fri 9/17.
- Karhik (privacy lead, cc'd) to confirm SCC Module 2 compatibility and sign-off on any DPA redlines.
- If Finrize prefers Module 1/3 or controller-to-controller framing, flag that and we can route to Legal for a faster decision.

If helpful, we can loop in our Legal (external counsel) for a short review call next week.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_draft_v1.docx, SOC2_bridge_letter_stub.pdf

From: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Ariela Ramos <ariela@finrize.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Discovery call recap — security & compliance items

Team — forwarding Finrize's asks. See Ariela's note (above) and my replies. Quick internal alignment:

- Confirm Redwood stance: processor by default for customers' application data. Karhik, please call out any edge cases where our infra or analytics teams might shift that classification (i.e., if we ingest customer data for model training; Finrize does not plan that but flagging).
- SOC 2 artifacts: we need the bridge letter and controls summary packaged. Ops can generate the controls summary; legal can review the bridge letter.
- Questionnaire: Stephanie, please own the Finrize_Vendor_Q. Target: initial pass + answers in 3 business days (EOD Fri 9/17). If you need any technical detail (tokenization, log retention, KV cache behavior), ping me and I'll pull from infra.

Also, procurement asked whether we can accept SCC Module 2. Ariela prefers Module 2 as processor — I'll ask Legal to prioritize Module 2 redlines if they come back.

Thanks — looping Karhik for privacy sign-off and Stephanie for Q completion.

-Dylan

> > Hi Ariela — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.
> > [snip previous reply]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Ariela Ramos <ariela@finrize.com>, dylan.brooks@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap — security & compliance items

Hi Ariela — Stephanie here (security solutions). Thanks for the questionnaire — we reviewed and began filling it out. A few notes / asks from our side: 

- SOC 2: We can provide the controls summary and the bridge letter by EOD Fri 9/17 as committed. We'll also include an interim list of covered cloud providers and our encryption at-rest/in-transit statement.
- DPA / SCC Module: We are aligned to accept SCC Module 2 for processor relationships. We'll propose the standard Redwood DPA with Module 2 appended; please let us know if Finrize requires Module 2 + any specific additional processing clauses.
- Controller/Processor mapping: For clarity in the DPA, we'll include a short mapping table stating: Finrize = controller; Redwood = processor; processing purposes = inference, embeddings, logs for billing and debugging (30 days retention default). If Finrize needs a different retention window or logging exclusions, let us know and we'll propose options (e.g., redaction, shorter retention).

Attached items we will send in this thread: SOC2_bridge_letter_stub.pdf (finalized), Redwood_DPA_draft_v1.docx (with Module 2 appended), and a completed copy of Finrize_Vendor_Q.pdf (answers inline).

Action items for Finrize:
- Confirm you are comfortable with Module 2 + attached processing purposes and retention defaults, or propose amendments.
- Provide any specific legal contact for DPA redlines (name, email).

If everything looks good, Dylan — we can aim to hand this to Legal for a contract-ready redline by next Tue 9/21.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Security Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_bridge_letter_stub.pdf, Redwood_DPA_draft_v1.docx, Finrize_Vendor_Q_completed.pdf
